name: 项目综合看板
description: 一级看板：项目综合态势总览，进度为主轴 + 异常标红，核心维度：项目 + 科室。

sqlConfig.query: WITH progress AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.project_no) AS project_total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 THEN s.project_no END) AS project_active, SUM(s.completed_total_cnt) AS completed_sum, SUM(s.due_cnt + s.outside_completed_cnt) AS due_sum FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')), quality AS (SELECT SUM(q.open_issue_cnt) AS open_quality_issues FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 q WHERE q.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND q.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR q.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR q.dept = {{deptId}})), tech AS (SELECT SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii) AS pending_reform_cnt FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 t WHERE t.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND t.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR t.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR t.dept = {{deptId}})), risk AS (SELECT SUM(r.high_cnt) AS high_risk_cnt FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 r WHERE r.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND r.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR r.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR r.dept = {{deptId}})) SELECT p.project_total AS "项目总数", p.project_active AS "进行中项目", CASE WHEN p.due_sum = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.completed_sum::numeric / p.due_sum::numeric * 100, 1) END AS "项目完成率", COALESCE(q.open_quality_issues, 0) AS "未闭环质量问题数", COALESCE(t.pending_reform_cnt, 0) AS "未整改落实技术更改单数", COALESCE(r.high_risk_cnt, 0) AS "高风险数量" FROM progress p, quality q, tech t, risk r

SELECT s.project_no AS "项目", SUM(s.on_time_cnt_v2) AS "按时完成", SUM(s.pending_normal_cnt_v2) AS "正常待完成", SUM(s.overdue_completed_effective_cnt) AS "超期完成", SUM(s.overdue_incomplete_effective_cnt) AS "超期未完成" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') GROUP BY s.project_no ORDER BY SUM(s.total_cnt) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(d.dept,'未填') AS "科室", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "按时完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_pending_normal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "正常待完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_completed_effective THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "超期完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_incomplete_effective THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "超期未完成" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR d.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') GROUP BY d.dept ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT s.period_month AS "月份", SUM(s.new_issue_cnt) AS "当月新增", SUM(s.open_issue_cnt) AS "月末未闭环" FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char(current_date - INTERVAL '11 months','YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') GROUP BY s.period_month ORDER BY s.period_month

SELECT v."分类", v."数量" FROM (
SELECT '设计' AS "分类", SUM(s.total_cat_design) AS "数量" FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '工艺',   SUM(s.total_cat_process)     FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '管理',   SUM(s.total_cat_management)  FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '元器件', SUM(s.total_cat_component)   FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '操作',   SUM(s.total_cat_operation)   FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '外协',   SUM(s.total_cat_outsource)   FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '软件',   SUM(s.total_cat_software)    FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '环境',   SUM(s.total_cat_environment) FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '其他',   SUM(s.total_cat_other)       FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
) v WHERE v."数量" > 0

SELECT s.period_month AS "月份", COALESCE(SUM(s.total_change_cnt),0) AS "变更总数" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') GROUP BY s.period_month ORDER BY s.period_month

SELECT COALESCE(s.dept,'未填') AS "科室", SUM(COALESCE(s.order_unsigned_cat_i,0)+COALESCE(s.order_unsigned_cat_ii,0)+COALESCE(s.order_unsigned_cat_iii,0)) AS "未签署", COALESCE(SUM(s.reform_pending_i_ii),0) AS "未落实整改" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND s.dept IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.dept ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(s.total_change_cnt,0)) DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT s.project_no AS "项目", SUM(s.high_cnt) AS "高风险", SUM(s.mid_cnt) AS "中风险", SUM(s.low_cnt) AS "低风险" FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') GROUP BY s.project_no ORDER BY SUM(s.total_risk_cnt) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT v."风险类型", v."数量" FROM (
SELECT '技术' AS "风险类型", SUM(s.cat_technical_cnt) AS "数量" FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '进度', SUM(s.cat_schedule_cnt)  FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '成本', SUM(s.cat_cost_cnt)      FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '设计', SUM(s.cat_design_cnt)    FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '质量', SUM(s.cat_quality_cnt)   FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT '其他', SUM(s.cat_other_cnt)     FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR s.dept = {{deptId}}) AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')
) v WHERE v."数量" > 0

WITH active_projects AS (SELECT project_no FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR dept = {{deptId}}) GROUP BY project_no HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) SELECT d.project_no AS "重大项目", COALESCE(d.subsystem, '(无子项目)') AS "子项目", d.node_task AS "任务", d.node_type AS "类型", to_char(d.plan_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "计划开始日期", to_char(d.plan_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "计划完成日期", to_char(COALESCE(d.actual_start_date, d.plan_start_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "实际开始日期", to_char(d.actual_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "实际完成日期", d.is_completed AS "是否完成", d.is_overdue_completed AS "是否超期完成", d.is_incomplete AS "是否未完成", COALESCE(d.delay_days, 0) AS "延期天数", d.risk_level AS "风险等级", d.completion_status AS "完成情况", d.dept AS "责任科室", d.owner AS "责任人", d.project_manager AS "项目经理" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d INNER JOIN active_projects ap ON ap.project_no = d.project_no WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR d.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR d.dept = {{deptId}}) ORDER BY d.project_no, d.subsystem NULLS LAST, d.plan_date
SELECT DISTINCT dept AS label, dept AS value FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE dept IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dept

WITH progress AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.project_no) AS project_total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 THEN s.project_no END) AS project_active, SUM(s.completed_total_cnt) AS completed_sum, SUM(s.due_cnt + s.outside_completed_cnt) AS due_sum FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')), quality AS (SELECT SUM(q.open_issue_cnt) AS open_quality_issues FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 q WHERE q.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND q.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR q.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR q.dept = {{deptId}})), tech AS (SELECT SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii) AS pending_reform_cnt FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 t WHERE t.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND t.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR t.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR t.dept = {{deptId}})), risk AS (SELECT SUM(r.high_cnt) AS high_risk_cnt FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 r WHERE r.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND r.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (NULLIF({{projectNo}},'') IS NULL OR r.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND (NULLIF({{deptId}},'') IS NULL OR r.dept = {{deptId}})) SELECT p.project_total AS "项目总数", p.project_active AS "进行中项目", CASE WHEN p.due_sum = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.completed_sum::numeric / p.due_sum::numeric * 100, 1) END AS "项目完成率", COALESCE(q.open_quality_issues, 0) AS "未闭环质量问题数", COALESCE(t.pending_reform_cnt, 0) AS "未整改落实技术更改单数", COALESCE(r.high_risk_cnt, 0) AS "高风险数量" FROM progress p, quality q, tech t, risk r
